rubrics.justification: The model explicitly stated no image was available and did not fabricate embryo morphology; therefore it avoided inaccurate morphological claims.
It integrated age, BMI, AMH/FSH, ovarian response, sperm parameters, endometrium, diagnosis, and prior miscarriage into prognosis, though some links were conditional on assumed embryo quality.

The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with probability estimates clearly framed as dependent on assumed blastocyst quality; minor overreach remains because estimates were given without actual morphology.

Most recommendations are broadly evidence-based, but suggesting routine PGT-A, thrombophilia screening, ERA, and broad miscarriage workup after a single prior clinical miscarriage is more aggressive than standard guideline-based practice.
Provides practical next steps for transfer counseling, luteal support, obtaining morphology, and contingency planning, though some future recommendations are somewhat generic or overinclusive.
